column7: Promise: 'Know every deal. Coach every rep. Forget nothing.'; one memory in three layers. Layer 1 ('What was said') is backed by Built call capture (calendar sync, transcripts, call summaries) and documents (Content Library); its email and Slack sources are In build / Planned. In build: 'Memory layers two and three: what calls meant, and what happened next'. Flagged by the Narrative: 'Connecting the dots (the pricing example)'.
column8: INTERPRETATION (analyst view, not capability claims): Overlap: four of five frame accumulated context as value. Aligned is closest to PitchSense's promise ('Aligned Brain' builds 'a living point of view' per deal and 'already knows your deals'); Humantic sells compounding across its own modules ('Connected, they compound'); Circleback and tl;dv scope memory to meetings (cross-meeting search, 'aggregated insights'), and Circleback's 'Company Brain' wording sits only in its <title>. Rox shows architecture labels (Knowledge Graph, Secure Knowledge Layer) rather than a memory promise. Difference: none of the five uses 'shared memory' or claims one memory connecting calls, deals, content and coaching; Aligned's Brain is deal-scoped and buyer-room-centred. Opportunity (testable hypothesis): 'one memory across call, deal, content and practice' may still be unclaimed in this batch, but Aligned's Brain is the nearest counterexample and must be checked on its /ai and /seller-agent pages before treating the integration angle as open. NARRATIVE V1 RECONCILIATION (Oct 19, 2026): PitchSense's Built memory is Layer 1 only (call capture: calendar sync, transcripts, call summaries; documents via the Content Library); email and Slack sources are In build / Planned and memory layers two and three ('what calls meant, and what happened next') are In build. Public copy can describe call and document memory only; the connected call→deal→content→coaching story stays out of public copy until the In-build layers ship.
